reasoning: On the season so far the Mavericks are the stronger team; with home court the Mavericks start about 5 points better, in a game of about 230 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Mavericks.
No psychological spot stands out for either team.
Bottom line: the Mavericks win 68 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 204 and 252 total points.
